case.query: Ugh, the utility room must be too warm, I can feel a little sweat just thinking about going in there to grab the laundry, kind of makes me want to put it off

transcript.text: This plan checks whether the utility room temperature is at or below 26.18 C. If it already meets that target the plan ends immediately; if not, it opens the temperature sensor for inspection and then waits up to 120 seconds, checking every 5 seconds for the temperature to fall to 26.18 C or below. The plan cannot change heating or cooling settings automatically - it only focuses the sensor so you can inspect or manually adjust controls. Does this plan look good to you?
